what: the default cost table of tools/q35_format_plan.py: per card, per format, per shape class, the time a decode stage costs as a fixed part plus a per-byte part. Every number cites the published figure it comes from; entries that are not measured say so (fixed_us / per_byte_us null, measured false or "total-only" or "other-model"), and every prediction that uses them is flagged in the output. Predicted times are a model, never a measurement.

XTX.guard_source: docs/dev/benchmarks.md:97 (the XTX's guard line 23,800 MiB with a 512 MiB reserve kept; python/caminus/serve/stats.py PhysicsConfig guard_mib / reserve_mib defaults)
XTX.source: docs/dev/qwen38-27b.md:32 ("the 858 GB/s the RX 7900 XTX's memory delivers to this kind of read"; the decode-floor study's sustained rate, docs/dev/qwen3-30b-a3b.md#decode-how-fast-it-writes). The card's read peak 952 GB/s (docs/dev/yardsticks.md:476) is not used: a token cannot sustain the peak.

XT.assumption: the streaming rate is used for matvec reads; the XT's decode-read rate is not published (docs/dev/yardsticks.md: "the XT's read peak is not measured")
XT.guard_source: docs/dev/benchmarks.md:97 (the XT's guard line 19,850 MiB; no display reserve on it)

entries.source: docs/dev/qwen3-30b-a3b.md#where-the-remaining-time-is ("Every weight stage of a layer costs 3 to 5 us on top of its bytes, whatever its size")
entries.note: the top of the published 3-5 us range. The output head's measured stage (300.6 us for 255 MB against 297.5 us at bus speed, 99% of the bound) sits inside the range.

entries.source: docs/dev/benchmarks.md:517 (the 0.4.0 IQ2_S census alone on the XT, own tile: ffn_gate 63.2 us; ffn_up 61.5 us in the same row)
entries.note: per-byte only: the fixed / per-byte split is not measured at this shape; fixed counted as 0. 451.7 GB/s over the 28,549,120 bytes.
328.2 GB/s. The same table's interleaved old/new columns (docs/dev/benchmarks.md:507-517) and the "about 60% of the read ceiling" figure for IQ2_S's matvec are the same measurement family.

entries.source: docs/dev/qwen3-30b-a3b.md#where-the-remaining-time-is ("Add + norm (twice) ... 3.6 us each", one traced token's add_rms16)
entries.note: measured on Qwen3-30B-A3B's module (48 blocks); the qwen35 line's add + norm is not measured.

measured on the 30B at 8 positions; the per-position KV bytes are added at the card's read rate (kv_pos_bytes x depth), not in this fixed part. The qwen35 line's attention fixed cost is not measured (its split pair at short context: docs/dev/qwen38-27b.md).

entries.source: docs/dev/qwen3-30b-a3b.md#where-the-remaining-time-is ("the stages that read no weights take 1.09 ms per token" in total on the 30B: attention, two adds and norms, the router's top 8 — not split per op)
entries.note: unmeasured per op for the qwen35 line: the GDN conv / l2 / step / save / norm, qk_nr, kv_append, gate_mul, SwiGLU segments. Counted as 0 and flagged.

entries.source: unmeasured: no published figure for the embedding row's segment (docs/dev/qwen38-27b.md counts its bytes in the 16.48 GB a token reads, not its fixed cost)
entries.note: counted as 0 and flagged; the row's bytes are charged at the read rate.

reference_tokens.note: published whole-token decode times, printed by the tool as a yardstick only (never used by the cost model)

XTX.source: docs/dev/benchmarks.md, the Qwen3.8-27B GSQ-RCO IQ3_S section (55.5 tok/s, tests/engine/test_q35_dense.py)
docs/dev/qwen38-27b.md:32-34 (one token reads 16.48 GB at 858 GB/s: 52 tok/s is the bound from the weights alone)
